context:
Goal: after a card sinks, you reach the next open item with nothing else jumping.
Problem (rule): house rule ux-press-moves-nothing now lets 3 kinds of row move when a sent card sinks (PR #1375): the row that leaves, the rows that close its gap, and the rows that make room where it lands. A count badge or section header that shifts as a result still fails the rule's check.
Based on (ruling): your item 313 a, 16:47 CST Nov 6.
Departs from: main, a press moves no other content — adds an exemption for the badge and header shifts a sink causes.
Meanwhile: nothing waits on this; #1374 and #1375 go to the batch as they stand.

options.gain: The sinking-card design passes review as built.
options.label: Exempt badge and header shifts too
options.lose: A badge may shift when you send.

options.label: Keep the exemption to rows only
options.lose: Lane page-answered-sink must pin badge and header widths, or fail review.

reply: Closed 12:17 CST Nov 7: PR #1375 merged in batch 55 (#1415, 12:06 CST).
short: Card sinks: may a badge shift?
title: When a sent card sinks, may a count badge or section header shift too?
why: Your 313 a let rows move when a card sinks. A badge or header that shifts as a result still fails the rule.
